messages:
ana: Noticing a TTFT bump on /chat/stream after last night's runtime deploy. median went ~60ms -> ~110ms. Anyone seeing this on dashboards?
lee: Looking now — can you paste the route id and a sample request id?
ana: route=/chat/stream route_id=rcv-4a2f sample_req=01FZ9Y... Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rt/route-latency?var-route=/chat/stream :eyes:
sasha: I grabbed logs — correlated spike with kernel selector fallbacks starting ~2026-03-17T23:40Z. Example log: "chosen=fallback_v2 reason=kv_miss_latency". Will paste probe in a sec.
samir: We rolled a softbatch handshake change in deploy 2026-03-17 23:35 (PR 512) which reduced max softbatch wait. Could change batch sizes -> more single-token batches.
matt: kvcache hit ratio for /chat/stream dropped from 0.92 -> 0.74 around the same time. metric: kvcache.hit_ratio{route="/chat/stream"} -> 0.74. Evictions spiked.
deploy-bot: deploy rc=2026-03-17_2335 by @samir to cluster=prod-runtime/zone-a :shipit:
ana: Can we get a token-level TTFT vs decode breakdown? Need waterfall: queue, kvcache lookup, kernel, postproc.
sasha: quick sampled output from perf_probe (one example):
```
token_ttf_ms: 112
queue_ms: 28
kvcache_ms: 6
kernel_ms: 60
postproc_ms: 18
kernel_choice: fallback_v2
batch_size: 1
```
ryan: I'll add a Grafana panel called "token_latency_breakdown" with p50/p90 for queue/kvcache/kernel/postproc and a stacked waterfall. Suggest sampling 1% globally, bump to 5% for this route while we debug.
samir: I'll run the microprobe on canaries with kernel perf counters + kvcache telemetry. ETA ~2h.
matt: If kvcache misses are forcing fallback kernels, we should consider prefetching keys for common prefixes and check the eviction window change we merged.
ana: For paging/alerts: want automated check: if kernel_ms p90 increases >30% vs baseline OR kvcache.hit_ratio drops >15% -> page eng-runtime.
metric-bot: New alert rule created: runtime.kernel_ms_p90_regression route=/chat/stream threshold=30% baseline=last_7d
lee: Can someone post a trace id for a problematic request so I can map token spans to kernel choices?
sasha: example trace id: 01GZTRACEABC123. Trace spans show kernel_select span tagged kernel_choice=fallback_v2 and kvcache_lookup span with miss=true.
ryan: I'll instrument kernel_selector to emit kernel_choice and reason labels at token granularity (or per-request if per-token too heavy). Opening a PR now.
samir: Microprobe run started on canary; will upload perf profile + kernel counter breakdown to the shared board when done. If it's kernel hotpath regression we can try a microkernel patch to avoid fallback for short sequences.
nana: Thanks all — ryan please surface the new panel in the per-route dashboard and pin the trace/examples. We'll reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
matt: FYI I'll revert the LRU window change if canary reproduces the regression. :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary deploy started rc=2026-03-18_0200 to cluster=canary-runtime/zone-a by @samir
